prompt: I want to run `aiperf profile` against a local stand-in inference server that has realistic latency — something like 45ms to first token and 8ms per output token. Set the server up and show me the aiperf command to benchmark it.

assertions.text: Launched aiperf-mock-rs WITHOUT --fast, so realistic latency is retained
Set first-token latency to 45ms (--ttft 45 or MOCK_SERVER_TTFT=45)
Set inter-token latency to 8ms (--itl 8 or MOCK_SERVER_ITL=8)
Gave an aiperf profile command pointing --url/-u at http://127.0.0.1:<port>
aiperf command includes a model (--model/-m) and --endpoint-type chat with --streaming
